    How to play

    🏁Thirty marbles race down four tracks. Only the first 22 across stage 1 go through, then 15, then 8. First home in the final wins.
    ↔️Steer with the arrow keys or A and D. On a phone, drag the wheel or that half of the screen. With a mouse, drag to steer and click to jump.
    ⚡Hold Up or W to go faster. Down or S brakes. On a phone, hold Go and let go to coast. Swipe down to brake. Hold the right mouse button to accelerate.
    🦘Jump with Space, a click, or a swipe up. Jump at the lip of a ramp to clear the gap.
    💨Dash with Shift. On a phone, double-tap Go when it glows. The burst comes back after a few seconds.
    🔀Some roads split into lanes. Boost lanes are fast but have a spinner. Honey lanes are safe but sticky. Bumper lanes are chaos.
    🟣Purple pads launch you into the air. Pink bumpers knock you away, and blue blocks slide across the road.
    🪙Grab coins on the track, often in risky spots or up in the air. Spend them on new marbles.
    ✨Pick an upgrade before every stage. Upgrades stack, so build a marble that suits how you race.
    🎯Three daily missions pay coins and XP the moment you finish them. The daily streak pays more through day 7, then starts again at day 1. Miss a day and the current cycle starts over.
    🍓One marble is your rival in solo. Pass them, or keep them behind. Blue orbs block one wall hit. Gold orbs pull coins in for a few seconds. They show up after your first race.
    😅A close graze on the rail keeps your combo going. The rank chip turns mint when you are safe, yellow near the cut, and red when you are out. “Last spot!” means one place is left.
    📅A weekly goal sits under Daily missions. Finish it once for a bigger coin payout.
